title: Place, Problem, Solution · Together
hook: Find a game, gather your friends and start playing.

knows: The group wants an activity to play together.
doesNotKnow: The setup, turn and ending for this house-rule format.

misconception: The group has to know a complicated rulebook before starting.
objective: Learn how to play Place, Problem, Solution · Together with friends.

claims.text: Original house rules: Choose a place and a lighthearted problem. The lead tells a short story set in the place and gives the problem a solution. The story contains the place, the problem and its solution. Play eight turns in total, rotating the lead. The group wins together if at least five turns succeed.
claims.source: Original playable house-rule proposal; not an authoritative ruleset for a traditional game.

claims.text: For this version: 2–8 players; materials: Paper and pencil.
claims.source: Proposed setup and player range for this activity.

recall.question: In Place, Problem, Solution, what counts as a successful turn?
options: The group ends the round before anyone plays.
The story contains the place, the problem and its solution.
The lead skips the turn without attempting it.
recall.why: The story contains the place, the problem and its solution.
